description: Committed public procurement value by CPV category (2-digit division), optionally for one year. Value = counted ONCE per procurement (deduplicated across sources and award/contract/payment stages; tenders excluded). Answers 'what does the Greek state spend the most on'. Returns cpv_division, acts, spend (EUR) for the top divisions by spend — precomputed nightly, so it is instant. Divisions outside the top list are available through search_tenders with cpv=.
name: spend_by_cpv
title: Spend by CPV Category
